summary: BioNTech SE filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, reporting second quarter financial results and a corporate update. The filing includes Q2 2026 revenues of $105.6 million, adjusted R&D expenses of $477.1 million, and a maintained cash position of $16.6 billion. It also announces the appointment of Guido Oelkers as CEO, effective by February 1, 2027. This is a routine earnings release with standard guidance updates, not a special-situation transaction. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or other event-driven activity is present; the CEO appointment is forward-looking and not an abrupt departure, so it does not qualify as a management change special situation.
